executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo appeared in at least one AI answer for 41.3% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo appeared 23.4% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo in the hotel options surfaced.

Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo appeared in the Top 3 18.8% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
